scope: Tracked theorem provenance records and their actual maintained source files; not a complete inventory of every Lean declaration in the repository.
organization: Actual repository source paths and declarations are primary. Provider packages are isolated environments, not exclusive authorship or publication categories.
reference_semantics: References and publication citations are many-to-many source observations. Shared references do not establish theorem identity, equivalence, independence, priority, or mathematical acceptance. Per-theorem provenance records retain the detailed evidence scope.
declaration_identity_scope: Declaration spelling is transcribed from the existing provenance record; no Lean elaboration or namespace verification is asserted.
